title: Emergency services levy: annual determination of ESL categories and rates
made_under: Fire and Emergency Services Act 1998 (WA) Part 6A, ss 36G-36I (Minister to determine the levy each year; rates by reference to gross rental value; minimum and maximum levy); the levy so determined is imposed by the Emergency Services Levy Act 2002 s 4
published_in: Western Australian Government Gazette, published on https://www.legislation.wa.gov.au/legislation/statutes.nsf/gazettes.html (one determination per financial year, usually gazetted in June for the year from 1 July)
located: not located: the Gazette list for 2026 (gazettes2026.html) gives only issue number, date and pages, with no notice titles, so finding the 2026-27 determination would mean downloading and reading Gazette issues one by one; not done, since the text could not be deposited in any case
